Data Engineer | Azure | Databricks | PySpark | ETL | SQL | Open to opportunities in Gurgaon | Immediate Joiner
3mo •
A lot of you have reached out to me asking for interview preparation videos and guidance.
This time, I wanted to do it in a more structured and practical way.
🎯 So, I'm starting a new YouTube series: Interview Preparation Series
In this series, I'll cover:
✅ PySpark Interview Questions
✅ SQL Interview Questions
✅ Data Engineering Scenarios
✅ Real Interview Questions Asked by many Companies
✅ Hands-on Explanations with Examples
✅ Tips to Crack Data Engineer Interviews
Whether you're a fresher, an aspiring Data Engineer, or someone preparing for product-based and analytics companies, this series will help you strengthen your concepts and boost your confidence.
📺 Episode 1 is live now! ( Interview Question asked in Tiger Analytics)
I'd love your support and feedback. If you find the content useful, feel free to like, share, and subscribe.
